name: ensembl_gtf
description: Ensembl GTF, TSS, and gene body annotation, with contig names left as Ensembl wrote them. This is refgenie's stock ensembl_gtf recipe with the two `sed 's/^/chr/'` calls removed. Upstream prepends 'chr' to the derived BEDs because those recipes feed pipelines that assume a UCSC- or GENCODE-named genome, i.e. the case where an Ensembl GTF is paired with a non-Ensembl FASTA. refdata-flow fetches the FASTA and the GTF from the same provider, so an Ensembl genome has contigs named 1/2/X/MT and the rewrite produced BEDs referencing chr1/chr2 that match nothing in the vault. The GTF itself is byte-identical to the stock recipe's; only ensembl_tss and ensembl_gene_body differ, and only in contig naming.

required_files.description: Annotation file in Gene Transfer Format (GTF) from Ensembl

command_list: gzip -dcf {asset_outfolder}/{genome}.gtf.gz | grep 'exon_number "1";' | awk -v OFS='	' '{{print $1, $4, $5, $20, $14, $7}}' | sed 's/";//g' | sed 's/"//g' | awk '{{if($6=="+"){{print $1"	"$2+20"	"$2+120"	"$4"	"$5"	"$6}}else{{print $1"	"$3-120"	"$3-20"	"$4"	"$5"	"$6}}}}' | LC_COLLATE=C sort -k1,1 -k2,2n -k4,4 -u > {asset_outfolder}/{genome}_ensembl_TSS.bed

gzip -dcf {asset_outfolder}/{genome}.gtf.gz | awk '$3 == "gene"' | awk -v OFS='	' '{{print $1,$4,$5,$14,$6,$7}}' | sed 's/";//g' | sed 's/"//g' | awk '$4!="Metazoa_SRP"' | awk '$4!="U3"' | awk '$4!="7SK"'  | awk '($3-$2)>200' | awk '{{if($6=="+"){{print $1"	"$2+500"	"$3"	"$4"	"$5"	"$6}}else{{print $1"	"$2"	"$3-500"	"$4"	"$5"	"$6}}}}' | awk '$3>$2' | LC_COLLATE=C sort -k4 -u > {asset_outfolder}/{genome}_ensembl_gene_body.bed
